title: LongOmicsTraj: topology-based representation and querying of short longitudinal omics trajectories
description: R package for representing visit-level longitudinal omics estimates as Ordinal Trajectory States (OTS) and querying them across experimental groups.

creators.name: Zounemat-Kermani, Nazanin
creators.affiliation: National Heart & Lung Institute and Data Science Institute, Imperial College London, London, United Kingdom
